title: CmdPal: Fix item subscription races during cleanup (part 1)

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: Live upstream head remains 952d380886abf321658ee61be75ea04b27f597d2 and upstream PR 50487 is still conflicting. A non-force merge of fork base 875be8f05ae9cccca81ea19bdad22c5057bbb8b2 into fork branch pr-iterate/50487 was retried and reproduced content conflicts in CommandItemViewModel.cs, CommandViewModel.cs, and ListItemViewModel.cs; the merge was aborted, leaving the durable branch unchanged at f5fbec3956dfcfe4d059fa3509122806f2fb87dd.

next_action: Resolve the lifecycle/context-menu conflicts in the dedicated fork local checkout, commit the merge as a descendant, and push normally without force; then recheck fork PR 754, ground against upstream head 952d380886abf321658ee61be75ea04b27f597d2, and run exact-head validation before any new Copilot request.

reconciliation.remediation: In <PowerToysCheckout> resolve the lifecycle/context-menu conflicts while preserving the PR cleanup-race fixes and current upstream command/page/context-menu behavior; run focused CmdPal ViewModels tests/build, commit the merge as a descendant of f5fbec3956dfcfe4d059fa3509122806f2fb87dd, push pr-iterate/50487 normally (no force), then recheck PR 754 and exact upstream-head validation. Do not issue a new Copilot request until the reconciled branch is validated.

upstream_grounding.reason: The saved Copilot finding targets code present only in the preserved fork review tree, not the current upstream PR diff. The fork base branch is current, but the fork PR metadata still reports the prior base snapshot and the fork head has not been rebased or rebuilt against the current upstream tree.
